newsitem.title: FINLAND: NATO's Solana arrives in Finland.
newsitem.headline: NATO's Solana arrives in Finland.

text.p: NATO Secretary-General Javier Solana arrived in Finland on Wednesday on the first official visit by a head of the Western alliance to the formerly isolated country.
Solana went direct to a meeting with Finnish Foreign Minister Tarja Halonen and was due on Thursday to meet leaders including President Martti Ahtisaari and Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen.
The head of the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation came to Finland from Sweden as part of a short tour of the Nordic neutral countries, although Finland now prefers the term "non-aligned".
